from pathlib import Path
import re,itertools,copy,hashlib,json,base64,zlib
prefix="brilliant_scientist_mengele_"
base="mengele_event016_"
defs={}
const={}
def parse(text):
    ts=[t for t in re.findall(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|#[^\n]*|[{}=<>]|[^\s{}=<>#"]+',text) if not t.startswith('#')]
    pos=0
    def block():
        nonlocal pos
        out=[]
        while pos<len(ts) and ts[pos]!='}':
            k=ts[pos];pos+=1
            if k=='{':
                v=block();assert pos<len(ts) and ts[pos]=='}';pos+=1
                out.append(('__anonymous_block__','=',v));continue
            if pos>=len(ts) or ts[pos] not in ('=','>','<'):
                continue
            op=ts[pos];pos+=1
            if ts[pos]=='{':
                pos+=1;v=block();assert ts[pos]=='}';pos+=1
            else:
                v=ts[pos].strip('"');pos+=1
            out.append((k,op,v))
        return out
    value=block()
    assert pos==len(ts), ('unconsumed tokens',ts[pos:pos+5])
    return value

class Model:
    def __init__(self,definitions=defs):
        self.defs=definitions;self.temp={};self.vars={};self.arr={};self.flags=set();self.completed=set();self.research=set();self.tech=set();self.provider=True;self.modifiers=[];self.retry=0;self.retry_checks=False;self.query_count=0;self.dll=False;self.conservative=False;self.retry_mode=1;self.gtd=True;self.bridge_calls=[];self.tooltips=[]
    def read(self,s):
        if s.startswith('constant:'):return const[s[9:]]
        try:return float(s)
        except ValueError:pass
        if '^' in s:
            a,i=s.split('^',1)
            if i=='num':return len(self.arr.get(a,[]))
            i=int(self.read(i));return self.arr.get(a,[])[i] if i<len(self.arr.get(a,[])) else 0
        return self.temp.get(s,self.vars.get(s,0))
    def cond(self,b):return all(self.one(k,op,v) for k,op,v in b)
    def one(self,k,op,v):
        if k in ('AND','hidden_trigger'):return self.cond(v)
        if k=='OR':return any(self.one(*x) for x in v)
        if k=='NOT':return not self.cond(v)
        if k=='check_variable':
            d={k:v for k,o,v in v}
            if 'var' in d:a=self.read(d['var']);b=self.read(d['value']);op=d.get('compare','greater_than_or_equals')
            else:k,op,x=v[0];a=self.read(k);b=self.read(x)
            return {'=':lambda:a==b,'equals':lambda:a==b,'>':lambda:a>b,'<':lambda:a<b,'greater_than_or_equals':lambda:a>=b,'less_than_or_equals':lambda:a<=b,'not_equals':lambda:a!=b,'greater_than':lambda:a>b,'less_than':lambda:a<b}[op]()
        if k=='has_country_flag':return v in self.flags
        if k=='is_special_project_completed':self.query_count+=1;return v in self.completed
        if k=='is_special_project_being_researched':return v in self.research
        if k=='has_tech':return v in self.tech
        if k=='has_dlc':return self.gtd if v=='Gotterdammerung' else self.dll
        if k==prefix+'project_native_output_is_authentic':return True
        if k==prefix+'project_stage_provider_is_valid':return self.provider
        if k=='brilliant_scientist_can_research_mengele_cloning_prototype':return True
        if k in self.defs:return self.cond(self.defs[k])==(v=='yes')
        raise AssertionError(('unsupported trigger',k,v))
    def write(self,k,v,temp):
        if '^' in k:
            a,i=k.split('^',1);i=int(self.read(i));assert i<len(self.arr[a]);self.arr[a][i]=v
        else:(self.temp if temp else self.vars)[k]=v
    def run(self,k):
        before=set(self.temp)
        try:self.rawrun(k)
        finally:
            if self.conservative:
                for new in set(self.temp)-before:self.temp.pop(new)
    def rawrun(self,k):
        if k==prefix+'grant_native_custom_operational_package':
            body=self.defs[k];provider_if=next(v for name,op,v in body if name=='if')
            candidates=[v for name,op,v in provider_if if name=='if']
            clone_if=next(v for v in candidates if 'mengele_event016_cloning_theory_completed' in str(v))
            gate=next(v for name,op,v in clone_if if name=='limit')
            self.bridge_calls.append(self.provider and self.cond(gate))
            return
        if k==prefix+'reconcile_project_availability':return
        if k==prefix+'grant_conventional_stage_package':
            self.temp[base+'stage_package_applied']=1;return
        if k==prefix+'settle_native_electronics_deployment_from_radar':
            self.retry+=1
            if self.retry_checks:
                assert self.arr[base+'native_prototype_source_entries'][1]==4
                assert self.arr[base+'native_prototype_mode_entries'][1]==self.retry_mode
                assert base+'native_selected_electronics_radar' not in self.flags
            self.effect(self.defs[k])
            return
        self.effect(self.defs[k])
    def effect(self,b):
        taken=False
        for k,op,v in b:
            if k=='if':
                lim=next((v for k,o,v in v if k=='limit'),[])
                taken=self.cond(lim)
                if taken:self.effect([x for x in v if x[0]!='limit'])
            elif k=='else_if':
                if not taken:
                    lim=next((v for k,o,v in v if k=='limit'),[])
                    taken=self.cond(lim)
                    if taken:self.effect([x for x in v if x[0]!='limit'])
            elif k=='else':
                if not taken:self.effect(v)
                taken=True
            elif k in ('hidden_effect','custom_override_tooltip','ROOT'):self.effect(v)
            elif k=='tooltip':pass
            elif k=='custom_effect_tooltip':self.tooltips.append(v)
            elif k=='set_technology':
                for tech,_,level in v:
                    if tech!='popup' and self.read(level)>0:self.tech.add(tech)
            elif k=='while_loop_effect':
                lim=next(v for k,o,v in v if k=='limit');i=0
                while self.cond(lim):
                    self.effect([x for x in v if x[0]!='limit']);i+=1;assert i<=1000
            elif k in ('set_temp_variable','set_variable'):
                if v[0][0]=='var':d={k:v for k,o,v in v};key=d['var'];val=d['value']
                else:key,_,val=v[0]
                self.write(key,self.read(val),k=='set_temp_variable')
            elif k in ('subtract_from_temp_variable','add_to_temp_variable'):
                key,_,val=v[0];change=self.read(val)*(1 if k=='add_to_temp_variable' else -1);self.write(key,self.read(key)+change,True)
            elif k=='add_to_array':
                d={k:v for k,o,v in v};self.arr.setdefault(d['array'],[]).append(self.read(d['value']))
            elif k=='clear_array':self.arr[v]=[]
            elif k=='set_country_flag':self.flags.add(v)
            elif k=='clr_country_flag':self.flags.discard(v)
            elif k=='add_dynamic_modifier':self.modifiers.append(v[0][2])
            elif k=='force_update_dynamic_modifier':pass
            elif k in self.defs:self.run(k)
            else:raise AssertionError(('unsupported effect',k,v))

def child(b,k):return next(v for key,o,v in b if key==k)

class ReviewModel(Model):
    def __init__(self,definitions=None):
        super().__init__(defs if definitions is None else definitions);self.conservative=True;self.calls=[];self.tag='CXT'
    def one(self,k,op,v):
        if k=='tag':return self.tag==v
        if k=='NOT':return not any(self.one(*x) for x in v)
        if k==prefix+'project_native_output_is_authentic':return self.cond(self.defs[k])==(v=='yes')
        if k=='brilliant_scientist_is_current_host':return False
        return super().one(k,op,v)
    def rawrun(self,k):
        self.calls.append(k)
        if k==prefix+'grant_native_custom_operational_package':
            self.bridge_calls.append((self.read(base+'native_grant_family'),self.read(base+'native_prototype_result')));return
        return super().rawrun(k)

def constants(body,path=''):

            if k!='schema':constants(v,name)
        elif re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+(\.\d+)?',v):const[name]=float(v)

class S(ReviewModel):
    def one(self,k,op,v):
        if k=='is_in_array':
            d={a:c for a,b,c in v};return self.read(d['value']) in self.arr.get(d['array'],[])
        return super().one(k,op,v)
names=['command_core','power_link','containment_lattice','temporal_authenticator','delivery_architecture','fail_deadly_governor']
selectors=['native_component_output_source','native_component_mode','native_component_index','project_family','requested_stage','project_index','project_output_authorized','native_later_stage_source']
paid_names=['active_project_stage','active_cost_political_power','active_cost_support_equipment','active_cost_fuel','active_cost_civilian_factory_commitment']
def fixture(c=1,provider=True,theory=True,active=0,done=False,outer_result=True,definitions=None):
    m=S(definitions);m.provider=provider
    m.flags|={base+'provider_receipts_initialized',base+'singularity_component_entries_initialized'}
    if theory:m.flags.add(base+'singularity_theory_completed')
    for name in paid_names+['native_later_stage_deployment_source','native_later_stage_weaponization_source']:
        m.arr[base+name+'_entries']=[0]*15
    m.arr[base+'active_project_stage_entries'][14]=active
    for name in paid_names[1:]:m.arr[base+name+'_entries']=[411+i for i in range(15)]
    m.arr[base+'singularity_component_entries']=[];m.vars[base+'singularity_component_count']=0
    m.arr[base+'native_prototype_source_entries']=[901+i for i in range(15)]
    m.arr[base+'native_prototype_mode_entries']=[801+i for i in range(15)]
    if done:m.completed.add('sp:sp_brilliant_scientist_singularity_'+names[c-1])
    m.temp={base+'project_family':15,'brilliant_scientist_singularity_component':c,base+'native_component_output_source':0,base+'native_component_mode':0}
    if outer_result:m.temp[base+'native_component_recorded']=0
    return m
def state(m):return copy.deepcopy((m.arr,m.vars,m.flags,m.modifiers,m.tech))
def protected(m):return copy.deepcopy({k:v for k,v in m.arr.items() if k!=base+'singularity_component_entries' and k!=base+'singularity_component_mode_entries'})
def clean(m):
    assert m.read('brilliant_scientist_singularity_component')==0
    assert all(m.read(base+n)==0 for n in selectors),('selector leak',m.temp)
def literal(m,c):m.run(prefix+'native_completion_sp_brilliant_scientist_singularity_'+names[c-1])
def adopt(m,c):
    m.temp[base+'project_family']=15;m.temp['brilliant_scientist_singularity_component']=c
    m.run(prefix+'adopt_exact_completed_singularity_component')
def accepted(m,c):return c in m.arr[base+'singularity_component_entries']
def mode(m,c):return m.arr.get(base+'singularity_component_mode_entries',[0]*6)[c-1]
counts={};failures=[]
def suite(name,fn):
    try:counts[name]=fn()
    except Exception as e:failures.append({'suite':name,'error':repr(e)})

def fresh_matrix():
    n=0
    for c,provider,theory,done,active in itertools.product(range(1,7),[False,True],[False,True],[False,True],range(5)):
        m=fixture(c,provider,theory,active,done);before=protected(m);literal(m,c);ok=provider and theory and active==0
        assert accepted(m,c)==ok and m.read(base+'native_component_recorded')==int(ok)
        assert base+'native_observed_singularity_'+names[c-1] in m.flags and m.query_count==0
        assert protected(m)==before;clean(m)
        if ok:
            assert mode(m,c)==1;old=state(m);literal(m,c);assert state(m)==old and m.read(base+'native_component_recorded')==0
        else:assert base+'singularity_component_mode_entries' not in m.arr
        n+=1
    return n

def history_subsets():

        m=fixture(provider=provider,theory=theory,active=active,outer_result=storage)
        m.completed={'sp:sp_brilliant_scientist_singularity_'+names[i] for i in range(6) if mask&(1<<i)}
        m.temp.update({base+'project_family':15,base+'requested_stage':1,base+'project_index':14,base+'project_output_applied':1,base+'computation_output_applied':37,base+'stage_output_gap':38,base+'project_output_authorized':0,base+'project_availability_reconciled':39,'brilliant_scientist_singularity_component':93})
        outer={k:v for k,v in m.temp.items() if k in [base+'project_family',base+'requested_stage',base+'project_index',base+'project_output_applied',base+'computation_output_applied',base+'stage_output_gap',base+'project_output_authorized',base+'project_availability_reconciled','brilliant_scientist_singularity_component']}
        before=protected(m);m.run(prefix+'adopt_completed_native_after_theory');ok=provider and theory and active==0

        assert (base+'singularity_prototype_completed' in m.flags)==(ok and mask==63)

def permutations_and_first_mode():

            m=fixture();before=protected(m)

                else:literal(m,c)
                assert m.vars[base+'singularity_component_count']==i+1
                assert (base+'singularity_prototype_completed' in m.flags)==(i==5)

            assert m.arr[base+'singularity_component_entries']==list(order)
            assert protected(m)==before and m.modifiers.count('brilliant_scientist_singularity_prototype')==1
            original=state(m)
            for c in order:
                m.completed.add('sp:sp_brilliant_scientist_singularity_'+names[c-1]);adopt(m,c);literal(m,c)
            assert (m.arr,m.vars,m.modifiers,m.tech)==(original[0],original[1],original[3],original[4]);assert m.flags==original[2]|{base+'native_observed_singularity_'+name for name in names};n+=1
    return n

    return n

def untouched_root_proof():
    def roots(text):
        out={}
        for match in re.finditer(r'^([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*\{',text,re.M):
            name=match.group(1);depth=0
            for token in re.finditer(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|#[^\n]*|[{}]',text[match.start():]):
                value=token.group()
                if value not in ['{','}']:continue
                depth+=1 if value=='{' else -1
                if depth==0:out[name]=text[match.start():match.start()+token.end()];break
        return out
    allowed={SOURCE_PATHS[0]:{prefix+'adopt_completed_native_after_theory',prefix+'record_native_project_prototype',prefix+'record_singularity_component'},SOURCE_PATHS[1]:{prefix+'singularity_component_native_output_is_authentic'}}
    count=0
    for path,encoded in BEFORE_ZLIB_BASE64.items():
        before=roots(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded)).decode('utf-8-sig').replace('\r\n','\n'))
        after=roots(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        for name,body in before.items():
            if name not in allowed[path]:assert after[name]==body,('foreign or paid/terminal body changed',path,name);count+=1
    return count
suite('preexisting_paid_stage_weights_terminal_and_other_roots_byte_preservation',untouched_root_proof)
